consumers.usage: Its stair assembler resolves the effective player hull and maximum step height from walkability.json whenever an extraction request omits extraction_params.walkability; the values gate tread, landing and transition discovery. AUE embeds this document in its binary, fetched at every build by scripts/sync-aulibs.sh with a provenance manifest of the AULIBS commit and sha256, and reads it when AUE_GAME_PARAMS_DIR, a packaged games/ directory and a workspace checkout are all absent.
